posts.title: C++26 Pack Indexing
posts.description: C++26 pack indexing lets you select types and values from parameter packs directly with pack…[I], which removes a lot of tuple and index_sequence ceremony from metaprogramming utilities.

posts.title: Virtual Function Costs
posts.description: Measuring real performance cost of C++ virtual functions: vtable lookup overhead, branch misprediction, devirtualization, and when to avoid virtual dispatch.
